name: Muoi cheo
summary: Muối cheo is Phong Nha’s dipping salt for grilled chicken and other grilled meat. A second recipe makes it from basil, lá lội, lá canh, green chili, and salt, for boiled chicken.
taste: The herb recipe uses basil, lá lội, lá canh, green chili, and salt.
howToEat: Dip grilled chicken or grilled meat in it. The herb version goes with boiled chicken.
seoTitle: Muoi cheo — the Phong Nha salt
seoDescription: Muối cheo is Phong Nha’s dipping salt for grilled chicken and grilled meat. A herb recipe uses basil, lá lội, lá canh, and green chili.
